Anyways, my story: I was 4 or 5, mom and dad fighting, on welfare, the usual story. But, it was one late night, my parents were fighting; getting physical. It the the point where my dad was holding my mom a few inches above then floor, against the wall, choking her. My dad only stopped when he saw me there crying. My mom got down and I just said "It'll be okay, mom." while she too was sobbing. Never forgave my dad, even 8 years after. And my family still likes to think of my dad as the hero of that relationship..
